inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev4 beginner-GUI, posed CRAB/PROGRESSIVE UFO assembly and inherited native-format/mod-workspace/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev5 refines CRAB to a landed default, validates the native PROGRESSIVE barrier tilt, resolves HORNET C1, and adds the HORNET full-armor assembly.

progressive_ufo_barrier_orientation.interpretation: native authored barrier tilt; not corrected by catalog

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 87/87 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this candidate evidence.

limitations: HORNET full-armor preset is the fully revealed 125-BF sample-0 lattice snapshot; the later dynamic 45-slot C0 prism attack remains a separate unresolved assembly target.
CRAB default is the executable/ANM-backed landed combat-loop sample 1; the preserved crab_first_visible preset remains the genuine airborne sample-167 intro snapshot.
PROGRESSIVE UFO preset remains the first recovered five-part runtime formation; later dynamic phase/movement formations are not collapsed into its static catalog entry.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meters conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
True blended/multi-joint deformation is not encoded; triangles spanning rigid joint partitions are rejected because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX for multipart runtime entities.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX no-op evidence and dev7 retail skin-field evidence are inherited rather than rerun/bundled from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
